name: io.github.davidmosiah/clickbus-mcp
description: Unofficial local-first ClickBus MCP: places, trip prices and booking history. Book is fail-closed.

environmentVariables.name: CLICKBUS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal ClickBus ticket. Prefer `clickbus-mcp-unofficial auth --token` so this never sits in client config.

environmentVariables.name: CLICKBUS_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Set true to allow book and cancel. Default false (never pays).

environmentVariables.name: CLICKBUS_PRIVACY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: summary | structured | raw. Default summary (redacts GPS/street/phone).
